workItem: Keep the public sitemap aligned with the canonical public SEO route set and add a regression check that fails when sitemap coverage drifts from routeSeo.
workItemDE: Die öffentliche Sitemap mit dem kanonischen Public-SEO-Routensatz synchron halten und eine Regression-Prüfung ergänzen, die bei Abweichung zwischen Sitemap und routeSeo fehlschlägt.
ownerRole: Cross-cutting SEO requirements and verification; no productive PVC ownership
authorityGuard: SEO changes only sitemap/configuration verification and SEO evidence. No Frontend source, runtime/deployment, Governance, Compliance, AUTH, CTRL, ADR or ESS authority is changed. src/lib/routeSeo.ts remains reused read-only as the existing public SEO route source for this check.
releaseCondition: Release on Human merge, close, supersession or abandonment. PR creation remains exact-snapshot Human/Owner-gated; merge remains Human/CODEOWNER-only.
